name: 30228 · Hampton, GA
findings: ZIP 30228 (Hampton) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30228 (Hampton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30228 (Hampton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
